story_type: lone sailor missing for 12 days found by a Navy destroyer, small boat alongside
hook: Missing at sea for 12 days. Then a destroyer found him.
narration: This sixty seven year old sailor had been missing at sea for twelve days.
On November twenty seventh, he made two mayday calls. His boat was taking on water, forty six miles west of Kailua Kona.
Then nothing. A storm blew his boat about two hundred miles south of Hawaii.
The Navy said it left him without food or water for twelve days.
On December ninth, the destroyer USS Paul Hamilton reached him.
A destroyer is far too big to pull up beside a small sailboat, so sailors went across in a rigid hull inflatable boat.
They brought him food, water and medical care, right there in his cockpit.
outcome: The sailor was rescued and taken aboard the Paul Hamilton to wait for a Coast Guard cutter.
title: Missing 12 days, found by a destroyer
description:
On Dec. 9, 2014, the destroyer USS Paul Hamilton rescued a 67-year-old sailor whose boat had been missing south of Hawaii since he made two mayday calls on Nov. 27.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Barbers Point, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/380385/missing-mariner-rescued-after-12-days-sea
